sentences.text: Shri Dhananjay Mahadule - Advocate for the appellant.

Shri Surendra Kumar Gupta - Government Advocate for the
 respondent/State.

Heard on I.A. No. 10422/2024, which is first application under Section 389(1) of Cr.P.C. for
suspension of jail sentence on behalf of sole appellant -
Aftabuddin.

The appellant stands convicted and sentenced as under :-
 Conviction Sentence  Section  Act Imprisonment Fine if deposited Impri  376(3) I.P.C. 20 Years R.I. 100/- 
 376(2)(n) I.P.C. 20 Years R.I. 100/- 
 376(d) I.P.C. 20 Years R.I. 100/- 
 506 Part-2 I.P.C. 7 Years R.I. 100/- 
 5(L)/6 POCSO 20 Years R.I. 100/-
As per prosecution case, the appellant has committed rape upon prosecutrix on the pretext of marriage.

Incident was reported to the Police Station Nagda, Ujjain and offence was registered at Crime No.390/2022 for the offence under Sections 376(2)(n), 376(3), 323, 506, 376(d) of IPC and Section 5(L)/6 of POCSO.
Counsel for the appellant argued that the prosecution has failed to prove the age of the victim as minor.
It is submitted that in the birth 2 CRA-8587-2023 certificate there is overwriting in respect of the date of birth and therefore, the conviction and sentence is not sustainable.

sentences.text: Per contra, counsel for the State submitted that the present case is of gang rape and main allegation is against the present appellant.
After hearing learned counsel for the parties and going through the statement of the prosecutrix, we find that she has made specific allegations against present appellant.
There is no cross-examination to the prosecution witnesses who were examined in support of the date of birth of the victim.
Apart from that it is not a case of the appellant, where he has falsely been implicated because of some old rivalry with the victim family.
In absence of any such difference, the statement of the prosecutrix alleging against the accused persons cannot be distinguished.

We find that prima facie no case is made out for grant of suspension of jail sentence, accordingly,
I.A. No. 10422/2024 is dismissed.
(VIJAY KUMAR SHUKLA) (ALOK
JUDGE JU
